_note: Team decisions from Phase 0. These are our own engineering choices (DERIVED), not NASA data. Put your name in confirmed_by once the team agrees.

database.why: One file, no server to install. Easy to share and demo.

search_store.why: We will index fewer than 50 papers, so a simple in-memory index is enough. Move to FAISS only if it gets slow.

ranking_weights.why: Atmosphere, gravity and material matter most for the Moon habitat question. The weights must add up to 1.

gap_tolerances.why: How close a test has to be to count as 'directly tested'. 7 kPa is about 1 psi. These are starting guesses, so change them after looking at the real data.

min_runs_for_sufficient.why: Fewer than 3 runs near the scenario counts as INSUFFICIENT.

assistant_word_limit.why: Keeps the assistant's answers short and easy to check.
